Parkside at Meridian — Property Management Report
Third Quarter 2017
Prepared by: Western Management Services

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Property is performing well with stable occupancy and positive rent growth.

OCCUPANCY (as of September 30, 2017)
Total Units: 148
Occupied: 139
Vacant: 9
Physical Occupancy: 94.1% [NOTE: Rent roll shows 141 occupied = 95.3% — discrepancy to investigate]

LEASING ACTIVITY (Q3 2017)
New Leases: 12
Renewals: 24
Average New Rent: $1,095
Average Renewal Increase: 3.5%

FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS (Q3 2017)
Total Revenue: $440,250
Operating Expenses: $175,400
NOI: $264,850

MAJOR EXPENSES
Landscaping: $8,550 [NOTE: This is correct — T12 rekey shows $43,200/year = $10,800/qtr, but actual is $8,550/qtr = $34,200/year]

NOTABLE ITEMS
- Unit 214 has been offline for 3 months. Tenant abandoned, personal property remains. Legal proceeding in progress.
- Pool renovation completed ahead of schedule
- Crime prevention lighting upgrade approved for Q4

PREPARED BY:
Tom Bradley
Property Manager
Western Management Services
